request.text: Gentle rain landing on fern fronds and low woodland leaves. Delicate irregular fine patter with softly changing density, small quiet lulls, rounded tiny leaf contacts. Natural clean recording for subtle mixing. Only light leaf rain. No insects, cicadas, birds, tones, hum, buzz, electronic noise, music, voices, thunder, gusts, streams, rivers, flowing water, gutters, puddle splashes, loud drips or roof drumming.
